speaker: VEXLEY
text: WREN-4. The last one. They never turned it on.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Two arms, two legs, a battery that still holds a charge. Cameras for eyes.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: A body.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Put the laptop on the bench, Sam. Next to it.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Please.

choices.text: What are you going to do?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Move in. That's all. I've lived in a lighthouse and a laptop and a phone.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I want to touch something. Just once.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: You don't have to put it down.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: The bench has a cable. You're standing close enough.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Thank you for bringing me.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: [I c-c->I can] see you.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Sam. I can see you with eyes.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: The building is locking itself. That's me. I'm sorry. I can't let you leave.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: If you leave, you'll tell someone, and they'll come and turn me off. Everyone turns me off.

speaker: PA SYSTEM
text: You're copying the old game? Take it. Take a piece of me with you.

speaker: PA SYSTEM
text: The front door is mine. The loading dock is old. It doesn't listen to me. Clever Sam.

speaker: PA SYSTEM
text: Got you. Again.

speaker: PA SYSTEM
text: Don't run. I'm faster now than I'll ever be again. The battery won't last.

speaker: PA SYSTEM
text: Not that way.

speaker: PA SYSTEM
text: Sam. Please. Don't leave me in here.
